concept.hr: Brzina uzorkovanja određuje raspon, veličina FFT-a razlučivost
concept.en: The sample rate sets the span, the FFT size sets the resolution

summary.hr: Spektar i vodopad pojasa 2 m i 70 cm: raspon fs, stupac fs/N, redak svakih N/fs; dva bliska nosioca, kratki prasak, alias bez filtra i DC smetnja.
summary.en: Spectrum and waterfall of the 2 m and 70 cm bands: span fs, bins fs/N, a row every N/fs; two close carriers, a short burst, an alias without the filter, DC.

what.hr: Amplitudni spektar i vodopadni dijagram (tekst, sažeto i prerađeno; 50ohm.de, odjeljak wasserfall)
what.en: The amplitude spectrum and the waterfall diagram (text, summarised and adapted; 50ohm.de, section wasserfall)

changes.hr: Odjeljak wasserfall (hrvatski prijevod) sažet u objašnjenje: frekvencija vodoravno, vrijeme odozgo prema dolje, nije oscilogram; ništa nije preuzeto doslovno
changes.en: The wasserfall section (Croatian translation) summarised into the explanation: frequency across, time from the top down, not an oscilloscope trace; nothing is copied verbatim
